mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced business investment, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE falls below 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals deteriorating household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% over six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which increases the likelihood of aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3% for six consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied from UNRATE and PAYEMS) over two consecutive months signals increased labor supply, which can boost productivity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces demand for construction-related equities and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
